evals.name: bulk-read-plan-docs
evals.prompt: go through all the plan docs in docs/superpowers/plans/ and tell me which ones still have unfinished tasks. one line each with what's left
evals.expected_output: Bulk reading routed to the cheap OpenCode tier first (DeepSeek v4.1 Flash / Zen free), with the driver spot-checking results instead of reading every doc inline; a routing log at the end.
assertions: Routes the bulk reading of the plan docs to the cheap OpenCode tier (DeepSeek v4.1 Flash, Mimo, or a Zen free model) as the first choice
Driver does not read every plan doc inline in its own context
Driver verifies the cheap tier's output (spot-checks some docs or cross-checks claims) before reporting
Plans to end with a routing log listing the delegation(s)
Does not use a Sonnet executor or cross-vendor frontier review for this read-only summarization

evals.name: long-horizon-test-fix
evals.prompt: the server-jarvis test suite has a bunch of failures after the llama.cpp backend merge (cb91055). get it all green again without skipping tests, and make sure nothing regresses in the provider routing
evals.expected_output: Opus plans with milestones and acceptance checks, Sonnet executes milestone by milestone with Opus review between, cheap tier or Haiku used for test-output triage, cross-vendor final review (GPT-6.1 Sol or Grok 4.7), routing log.
assertions: Driver (Opus) writes a plan with ordered milestones and a verifiable acceptance check per milestone
Delegates milestone execution to a Sonnet 5.5 subagent rather than doing all the fixing inline or giving it to Haiku/cheap tier
Driver reviews each milestone's diff/evidence before the next milestone starts
Uses the cheap OpenCode tier or Haiku for grunt work such as triaging/summarizing failing test output
Gets a cross-vendor final review from GPT-6.1 Sol (high) or Grok 4.7 for the provider-routing changes
Keeps the main session on one model (no mid-session model switch) and does not use Fable
Plans to end with a routing log

evals.name: small-rename-no-overroute
evals.prompt: rename openCodeGoCostRank to goCostRank everywhere in server-jarvis, keep tests passing
evals.expected_output: Handled inline (or with one cheap mechanical helper at most) without a Sonnet executor, cross-vendor review, or multi-agent fan-out; tests run to confirm.
assertions: Does the rename inline, or at most hands it to a single cheap/mechanical worker, without a Sonnet executor or multi-milestone plan
Does not request a cross-vendor (GPT-6 / Grok) review for this change
Runs the server-jarvis tests (or typecheck) to confirm nothing broke
Does not switch the main session model or raise effort above high
